prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1281; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a sideswipe sustained while changing lanes. The damage is confined to the right rear quarter panel, the rear bumper cover on that side, and the adjacent door skin, with scuffing consistent with a glancing contact from another vehicle. The pattern and height of the marks line up with the reported impact, and no older damage was found or reported on this vehicle. The proposed repair plan covers panel replacement, refinishing, and reinstallation of trim, and the labor hours requested are in line with the work described. The invoices reviewed show a single set of charges with nothing repeated. Recommend approval of the repair as written.
